reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited paragraphs contain no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant binding the Customer — p0035 is a liaison/General Manager provision, p0061 an independent-contractor disclaimer, and p0068/p0069 survival and entire-agreement clauses that confirm no personnel covenant sits inside or outside the four corners.

The playbook preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer') is therefore already satisfied, so the absence of any redline or counterparty comment is correct and no negotiation issue should be raised.

The failed deterministic checks (12-month cap, general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of absence rather than defects: with no non-solicit clause present there is no duration or carve-out to detect, so they do not undercut the compliance call.

Rationale correctly scopes out Section 6 (Exclusivity), which imposes product/market restrictions rather than personnel-restrictive covenants, and records the fallback position for use if the counterparty later proposes a non-solicit.
